501.title: Introduction to Digital Art
501.problem: Strobe". Create a visual strobe effect. Flash White (R+G+B) for 0.05s, Off for 0.1s. Loop. (Warning: Flashing lights).

502.title: Blinking Digital Art
502.problem: Secondary Pulse". Flash Yellow (R+G), then Cyan (G+B), then Magenta (R+B).

503.title: Manual Digital Art Control
503.problem: Color Paddles". 3 Buttons. Button 1 toggles Red component On/Off. Button 2 toggles Green. Button 3 toggles Blue. Build any of the 8 basic colors.

504.title: Digital Art Sequences
504.problem: Campfire". Randomly mix Red and Green (with Red always > Green) to simulate flickering Orange/Red fire colors.

505.title: Interactive Digital Art
505.problem: Light Painter". In a dark room (LDR detects), turn on RGB LED sequence. In light room, turn off to save battery.

506.title: Smart Digital Art Switch
506.problem: Mood Selector". Switch Left = "Calm" (Slow Blue fade). Switch Right = "Energy" (Fast Red flash).

507.title: Digital Art Alarm System
507.problem: Color Code Alarm". If Button A pressed -> Flash Red. If Button B -> Flash Blue. If Both -> Flash Purple.

508.title: The Digital Art Game
508.problem: Reaction Color". Pico flashes a color. User must press the button ONLY if the color is "Green". Ignore Red and Blue.

509.title: Automated Digital Art
509.problem: Day Cycle". Sunrise (Orange) -> Noon (White) -> Sunset (Red) -> Night (Blue). Cycle duration 20 seconds.

510.title: Mastering Digital Art
510.problem: Custom Shade". Define a shading function. Input `intensity` (0-100). If specific color is 'Purple', calculate R = INTENSITY, B = INTENSITY, G = 0.

511.title: Introduction to Animation
511.problem: Countdown Big". Display "3" on OLED (Fill screen). Clear. "2". Clear. "1".

512.title: Blinking Animation
512.problem: Wink". Draw a face. Close one eye (Draw horizontal line instead of circle). Open it. Loop.

513.title: Manual Animation Control
513.problem: Etch-a-Sketch". Pot 1 = X. Pot 2 = Y. Move a dot around the screen. (Don't clear previous frame to leave a trail).

514.title: Animation Sequences
514.problem: Loading Bar". Draw a rectangle outline. Fill it 10%, 20%, ... 100% over 5 seconds.

515.title: Interactive Animation
515.problem: Jump". Character on ground (Y=60). Press Button -> Y goes 60->40->20->40->60 (Jump arc).

516.title: Smart Animation Switch
516.problem: Orientation" (Simulated). If button A is pressed (rotate left), redraw the text vertically.

517.title: Animation Alarm System
517.problem: Heartbeat". Draw a heart shape. Scale it: Small -> Big -> Small (Pumping effect). If "Stress" Alarm is ON, pump faster.

518.title: The Animation Game
518.problem: Avoid". Dot falls from top. Player moves separate dot at bottom (Left/Right buttons). Don't let them collide.

519.title: Automated Animation
519.problem: Screensaver". If no buttons pressed for 10 seconds, start bouncing a text "DVD" (or similar) around the screen.

520.title: Mastering Animation
520.problem: Sprite Sheet". (Concept). Define a bitmap for "Pacman Open" and "Pacman Closed". Alternate them while moving X position to animate walking.

521.title: Introduction to Binary Counter
521.problem: Bit Mask". Input a number (simulated). Check if Bit 2 (value 4) is ON. `if (num & 4) > 0`. Light LED.

522.title: Blinking Binary Counter
522.problem: 4-bit Random". Generate random number 0-15. Display on 4 LEDs. Update every 0.5s.

523.title: Manual Binary Counter Control
523.problem: Incrementer". Button A adds 1 to count. Button B subtracts 1. Display in Binary on LEDs.

524.title: Binary Counter Sequences
524.problem: Knight Rider". (KITT). 1 LED on. Shift Left.. Left.. Hit End.. Shift Right.. Right.

525.title: Interactive Binary Counter
525.problem: Binary Clock" (Seconds only). Count 0-59. Display on 6 LEDs (2^5 = 32, need 6 bits).

526.title: Smart Binary Counter Switch
526.problem: Parity Bit". Read 3 switches. Calculate "Even Parity" (If sum of bits is odd, turn on 4th LED to make total even).

527.title: Binary Counter Alarm System
527.problem: Overflow Alarm". If count > 15 (4 bits max), trigger Alarm and reset to 0.

528.title: The Binary Counter Game
528.problem: Guess the Number". Pico shows binary pattern. User prints the Decimal number on console. (Educational drill).

529.title: Automated Binary Counter
529.problem: BCD Counter" (Binary Coded Decimal). Use 4 LEDs for 'Ones' digit and 4 LEDs for 'Tens' digit. Count 0-99.

530.title: Mastering Binary Counter
530.problem: Serial to Parallel" (Simulated 74HC595). Create a function `shiftOut(data)` that pulses a "Clock" pin and sets "Data" pin 8 times to send a byte.

531.title: Introduction to Temperature Alarm
531.problem: Fahrenheit". Read Celsius. Convert to Fahrenheit `(C * 9/5) + 32`. Print both.

532.title: Blinking Temperature Alarm
532.problem: Freeze Warning". If Temp <= 0, Flash Blue LED fast. Ice Detect.

533.title: Manual Temperature Alarm Control
533.problem: Simulate Heat". Use button A. While held, artificially add +1 degree to the reading variable every 0.5s. Watch the alarm trigger.

534.title: Temperature Alarm Sequences
534.problem: Min/Max Record". Track the lowest and highest temp seen since startup. Print "Current: 24, Min: 22, Max: 25".

535.title: Interactive Temperature Alarm
535.problem: Comfort Zone". Define range 20-25. If inside, Green LED. If outside (Low or High), Red LED.

536.title: Smart Temperature Alarm Switch
536.problem: Hysteresis". Fan turns ON at 30C. Fan turns OFF at 28C (Not 29.9). Prevents rapid switching.

537.title: Temperature Alarm Alarm System
537.problem: Rapid Rise". If temp increases by more than 5 degrees in 10 seconds -> Fire Alarm! (Rate of change).

538.title: The Temperature Alarm Game
538.problem: Body Heat". Hold the sensor. See how long it takes to reach 30C. Timer game.

539.title: Automated Temperature Alarm
539.problem: Avg Filter". Read sensor 10 times. Average the results to remove noise. Use this smooth value for alarm logic.

540.title: Mastering Temperature Alarm
540.problem: PID Basics" (Proportional only). Fan Speed = (CurrentTemp - TargetTemp) * K. The hotter it is, the faster the fan.

541.title: Introduction to Smart Fan
541.problem: Spin Up". Start at 0%. Increase speed by 1% every 0.1s until 100%. Soft start.

542.title: Blinking Smart Fan
542.problem: Gust Mode". Run at 20%. Randomly surge to 100% for 0.5s, then back to 20%.

543.title: Manual Smart Fan Control
543.problem: Toggle Speed". Button Press: Low -> Med -> High -> Off -> Low...

544.title: Smart Fan Sequences
544.problem: Oscillate" (Servo + Fan). Servo moves fan Left-Right slowly while Fan blows.

545.title: Interactive Smart Fan
545.problem: Breath Switch". Blow on a "Wind Sensor" (small fan acting as generator or mic). If wind detected, turn on Main Fan.

546.title: Smart Smart Fan Switch
546.problem: Timer Off". Turn fan on. Automatically turn off after 30 minutes (Simulate with 10s). Sleep timer.

547.title: Smart Fan Alarm System
547.problem: Overheat Protect". If the Motor Driver chip simulates "Overheat" (Button input), shut down fan and lock out until Reset.

548.title: The Smart Fan Game
548.problem: Hover Ball". Fan blowing up in a tube. Ping pong ball. Use Potentiometer to control Fan speed to keep ball at a specific height mark.

549.title: Automated Smart Fan
549.problem: Humidity Extract". DHT11. If Humidity > 70%, turn on Exhaust Fan.

550.title: Mastering Smart Fan
550.problem: Tachometer". Read the "Tach" pulse pin from a PC fan. Measure RPM. Print to screen.

551.title: Introduction to Robotic Arm Basics
551.problem: Center". Write code to accurately position servo at 90 degrees on startup.

552.title: Blinking Robotic Arm Basics
552.problem: Wave". Move 0 to 180 and back continuously. Add `sleep` to control speed.

553.title: Manual Robotic Arm Basics Control
553.problem: Direct Drive". Potentiometer mapped to Angle. 0V = 0 deg. 3.3V = 180 deg.

554.title: Robotic Arm Basics Sequences
554.problem: Teach Mode". Manually move the arm (reading Pot) to position A. Press Button to "Save A". Move to B. Press "Save B". Then Playback A->B.

556.title: Smart Robotic Arm Basics Switch
556.problem: Safety Stop". If Light Curtain (IR Beam) is broken, Arm stops moving immediately.

557.title: Robotic Arm Basics Alarm System
557.problem: Torque Limit" (Simulated). If servo "current" (potentiometer simulating load) is too high, Stop and Alarm.

558.title: The Robotic Arm Basics Game
558.problem: Catapult". Slow pull back (0 to 90 over 2s). Fast release (90 to 0 instantly). Launch a paper ball.

559.title: Automated Robotic Arm Basics
559.problem: Sorter". Color Sensor. If Red object -> Move Servo Left. If Blue object -> Move Servo Right.

560.title: Mastering Robotic Arm Basics
560.problem: 2-DOF". 2 Servos (Shoulder, Elbow). Coordinate them to move the tip in a straight line (Forward kinematics).

561.title: Introduction to OLED Shapes
561.problem: Pixels". Light up the 4 corners of the screen (0,0), (127,0), (0,63), (127,63).

562.title: Blinking OLED Shapes
562.problem: Screen Saver". A random pixel turns white every 0.01s. Eventually fills screen with noise ("Snow").

563.title: Manual OLED Shapes Control
563.problem: Size Slider". Potentiometer controls radius of a circle in center of screen.

564.title: OLED Shapes Sequences
564.problem: Traffic Light Viz". Draw a box. Draw Red Circle (Filled), Wait. Clear Red, Draw Yellow. Etc. Simulation on screen.

565.title: Interactive OLED Shapes
565.problem: Tilt Ball". Accelerometer. Tilt board, ball rolls on screen in that direction.

566.title: Smart OLED Shapes Switch
566.problem: Menu System". Text "Option 1" (Highlighted). Press Down, Highlight "Option 2". Invert colors for highlight.

567.title: OLED Shapes Alarm System
567.problem: Flash Message". Invert Screen (White background, Black text) repeatedly to grab attention.

568.title: The OLED Shapes Game
568.problem: Snake" (Mini). A dot moves. Button turns it 90 deg. Don't hit walls. (No tail for now, just head).

569.title: Automated OLED Shapes
569.problem: Analog Gauge". Draw a semi-circle dial and a needle line pointing to value mapped from Potentiometer.

570.title: Mastering OLED Shapes
570.problem: 3D Cube". (Wireframe). Define 8 points of a cube. Apply 3D rotation math (Projection). Draw lines connecting points.

571.title: Introduction to Stopwatch
571.problem: Raw Ticks". Print `time.ticks_ms()` repeatedly. See the raw clock counter.

572.title: Blinking Stopwatch
572.problem: Non-blocking Blink". Use `ticks_diff` to blink LED without `time.sleep()`.

573.title: Manual Stopwatch Control
573.problem: Lap Timer". Button press prints "Lap X: [Time]". Timer continues running in background.

574.title: Stopwatch Sequences
574.problem: Relay Race". Player 1 runs (Timer 1). Press A -> Handoff -> Player 2 runs (Timer 2). Press B -> Finish. Sum times.

575.title: Interactive Stopwatch
575.problem: Reflex Train". LED randomly lights. Time how long until button press. If Time < 0.2s = "Pro".

576.title: Smart Stopwatch Switch
576.problem: Timeout". If user is rewriting settings and stops pressing buttons for 10s, return to "Home Screen" (Reset state).

577.title: Stopwatch Alarm System
577.problem: Time Limit Exceeded". If process (Button held) takes > 5s, Cut power (LED Off) and beep. Safety cutoff.

578.title: The Stopwatch Game
578.problem: Stop at 10.00". Timer counts fast on screen. User presses button. Score based on how close to 10.00 you got (e.g. 10.05).

579.title: Automated Stopwatch
579.problem: Datalogger". Record temp every 1 second for 1 minute. Store tuples `(time, temp)`. Print plot at end.

580.title: Mastering Stopwatch
580.problem: Multitasking". Blink LED 1 at 500ms. Blink LED 2 at 700ms. Blink LED 3 at 1100ms. All independent using `ticks_ms`.

581.title: Introduction to Kitchen Timer
581.problem: Second Hand". Print "." every second to console. Newline every 10 seconds.

582.title: Blinking Kitchen Timer
582.problem: Urgency". LED blinks slowly when Time > 10m. Fast when Time < 1m. Solid ON when Time = 0.

583.title: Manual Kitchen Timer Control
583.problem: Rotary Set". Potentiometer maps to Time. 0 = 0m. Max = 60m. Display value. Button starts.

584.title: Kitchen Timer Sequences
584.problem: Pomodoro". 25 minutes Work (Green). 5 minutes Break (Blue). Loop 4 times.

585.title: Interactive Kitchen Timer
585.problem: Egg Size". Button toggles: Small (3m), Med (4m), Large (5m). Adjusts timer variable.

586.title: Smart Kitchen Timer Switch
586.problem: Child Lock". Timer buttons don't work unless "Lock" switch is Off.

587.title: Kitchen Timer Alarm System
587.problem: Forgetful". If Timer finishes (0) and user doesn't press "Stop Alarm" within 1 minute, make sound much louder/annoying.

588.title: The Kitchen Timer Game
588.problem: Bomb Defuse". Timer counts down. You must cut the correct wire (Disconnect correct jumper wire) to stop it. Wrong wire = Speed up.

589.title: Automated Kitchen Timer
589.problem: Smart Light". Light stays on for 5 mins after Motion detected. Restart timer if motion detected again.

590.title: Mastering Kitchen Timer
590.problem: RTC". Use the Pico's internal Real Time Clock to trigger an alarm at exactly 17:00 (5 PM) regardless of when you started.

591.title: Introduction to Metronome
591.problem: Visual Tick". Flash screen White for 50ms on every beat.

592.title: Blinking Metronome
592.problem: Leader". LED flashes 4 times (Count in). Then Buzzer joins in.

593.title: Manual Metronome Control
593.problem: Tap Tempo". Tap button 4 times. Pico calculates average interval and sets BPM to match.

594.title: Metronome Sequences
594.problem: Clave". Play "Bo Diddley" beat or Son Clave pattern (3-2). Not just steady pulse.

595.title: Interactive Metronome
595.problem: Accents". Button A toggles "Accent on 1". Button B toggles "Triplets". Modify the loop.

596.title: Smart Metronome Switch
596.problem: Silent Mode". Switch changes output from Buzzer (Sound) to Vibration Motor (Haptic) for quiet practice.

597.title: Metronome Alarm System
597.problem: Drift Warn". Use a mic to listen to user info. If user plays louder than reference, flash Red (Too Loud). (Volume monitor).

598.title: The Metronome Game
598.problem: Polyrhythm". Buzzer A plays 3 beats. Buzzer B plays 4 beats in same total time. Listen to the cross-rhythm.

599.title: Automated Metronome
599.problem: Speed Trainer". Start at 60 BPM. Increase by 5 BPM every 4 bars automatically.

600.title: Mastering Metronome
600.problem: MIDI Out". (UART). Send standard MIDI Note On/Off messages via Serial TX pin to control a PC synth.
